mil3.7.10:1.3: ‘that the bones are long, hundreds of leagues long,’ but even a tree is not a hundred leagues long, so where do the bones, hundreds of leagues long, come from”?
mil3.7.10:2.1: “What do you think of this, Great King: have you heard ‘that in the great ocean there are fish bones five hundred leagues long’”?
mil3.7.10:2.3: “Surely, Great King, the bones of a fish five hundred leagues long will be hundreds of leagues long too”?
mil3.7.10:4.1: The Question on Long Bones, tenth.
